## Why

Explain the user problem and link the issue.

## What changed

Describe the behavior before and after. Disclose new network access, dependencies,
permissions, executable/build steps, or changes to capture, updates and publishing.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Use synthetic session data.

## Contribution provenance

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this code and any included assets under the repository's MIT license.
- [ ] Any third-party code/assets have their source, compatible license and required attribution included.
- [ ] I have not included credentials, personal session data, browser profiles or proprietary material.
- [ ] I have disclosed generated/copied code and checked its behavior and provenance.

An unchecked item is a prompt to explain the situation, not to make an unsupported claim.
